basic_profile.bio: I'm a 30-year-old gamer from Fargo, North Dakota, who recently picked up Dark Souls after hearing about its legendary difficulty. I work as a systems analyst, which keeps me busy during the day, but I enjoy unwinding with some gaming in the evenings. In my free time, I'm also exploring tabletop RPGs, particularly Powered by the Apocalypse games. Not a fan of overly competitive environments; I prefer co-op or PvE settings. I'm single and use Reddit mostly in the late evenings, around 8 PM to 11 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Information Technology, and most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing various RPGs and watching content creators like LGR. I enjoy learning by doing, so I often dive into games and figure things out as I go. Recently, I've also been delving into the lore of Dark Souls and the mechanics behind different builds.
